novelty.justification: The novel route is the mechanistic relationship in the claim that “decoding happens in later layers, after the refusal decision has been made,” coupled to a refusal check on the post-decode representation, rather than merely the known observation that cipher prompts bypass safeguards. Searches using “cipher jailbreak layerwise decoding refusal,” “encoded harmful prompt internal representations,” “Base64 jailbreak refusal direction,” and “late-layer harmful intent safety re-check” identify CipherChat (Yuan et al., 2024) as the closest behavioral work and Arditi et al.’s Refusal in Language Models Is Mediated by a Single Direction (2024), AISA (2026), and Refusal Lives Downstream of Persona in Chat Models (2026) as nearby representation-level work, but none establishes the specific decode-after-refusal ordering for encoded attacks. Moving from those works to a comparison between the layer at which decoded semantics becomes legible and the layer at which refusal is determined requires a new core relationship rather than a direct transfer, although the late-layer steering intervention itself is a natural consequence of that relationship, supporting high but not paradigm-level novelty.
